name: jq
purpose: Runs a jq filter over JSON input.
body: With no files, reads stdin. Exit status is 0 on success, 5 on a runtime error, 2 on a usage error, 3 on a compile error; with -e, 1 when the last output was false or null.

flags.meaning: strings raw, without JSON quotes (for text output)
don't read input; run once with null
slurp: read every input into one array
exit status from the last output (1 if false or null)
read the filter from a file
each input line is a string, not JSON
